description: This file defines a Kotlin class `BackupRestoreDialog` which is a UI dialog fragment used for restoring backups with biometric authentication in an Android app. It manages user interaction for initiating backup restoration, handles biometric authentication prompts, and displays success or error messages based on the backup restoration process.

classes.name: BackupRestoreDialog
classes.description: A DialogFragment that manages backup restoration with biometric authentication.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates the dialog UI for the backup restore process.

methods.name: authenticateAndRestore
methods.description: Handles biometric authentication and triggers backup restoration upon success.
